description: Attach a file whose bytes were PUT to the `uploadUrl` from anyforge_start_file_upload. Only the key holder who started the upload may complete it; completing twice returns the first result. `upload_incomplete` (409): the bytes have not all arrived. `upload_expired` (410): more than 24 hours passed; start again. `upload_size_mismatch` (400): the stored size differs, the bytes were discarded. If the same file (name and size) was attached meanwhile, the answer is that file with alreadyAttached: true and the new bytes are discarded; a same-name file of another size is `file_name_exists` (409) unless the start said keep_both.

id.description: The work item, initiative or program id.

target.description: The kind of record the file is attached to.

name: anyforge_complete_file_upload
title: Complete file upload
